decisions.reason: The citrus crate builds on existing crate expertise and agricultural customer knowledge, allowing the firm to learn and improve it.
The foldable container leverages the firm's container engineering and in-house R&D, making it closely related and likely to be refined.
Stackable plastic crates are a core standard product directly aligned with the firm's existing packaging knowledge.
Rackable pallets are a natural extension of the firm's pallet manufacturing capabilities, enabling application of existing know-how.
The spill-retention pallet extends the firm's pallet expertise with a safety feature that can be developed in-house.
Load-retaining pallets combine the firm's pallet and handling accessory knowledge, supporting learning and commercial application.
